subject: Scoped SCIM + RBAC artifacts — delivery plan and redaction notes
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medicore.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@medicore.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCIM delta + RBAC mapping for SIG follow-up

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this forward. As part of our SIG and internal SOC 2 pull we need a scoped export from Redwood covering the following items: 90-day SCIM delta (adds/changes/deletes), service-account inventory with owner mapping, and a model of how RBAC is applied to service accounts (roles -> permissions). We also need a SAML assertion sample for a successful user login (no PII), and a brief write-up of least-privilege controls (JIT, role reviews cadence).

Can you confirm what minimal artifacts you can provide by 2028-04-05? We prefer a secure upload (SFTP or your secure portal). Also please flag any fields you will redact or replace with placeholders — our auditors will want to know redaction rules.

I've attached our SCIM request template to make it concrete.

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Senior Security Manager, MediCore Health
phone: (415) 555-0189

Attachment: medicore_scim_request_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medicore.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + RBAC mapping for SIG follow-up

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can meet that timeline but want to confirm scope so we deliver exactly what your auditors need. Quick clarifying notes: 

- SCIM delta: we can export adds/updates/deletes for users and groups for the requested 90-day window. We will exclude password hashes and full login history.
- Service-account inventory: we can provide CSV with account id, display name, created_at, last_used (timestamp), owner (email), role_bindings. We will redact any internal UUIDs that are not useful for audit (we'll provide a mapping file instead).
- RBAC model: we will include current role definitions and a mapping of role -> allowed actions; for role bindings we will include only role name and subject (user/service-account id).
- SAML assertion: we will provide a sample assertion with names and emails replaced with placeholders (e.g., <redacted_email>) and include the assertion timestamp and audience info.
- Least-privilege write-up: 1-2 pages describing our role review cadence, ephemeral credentials for certain service accounts (where applicable), and delegated admin controls.

Delivery options: I can upload to your secure portal link if you provide it, or we can put a password-protected tarball on our secure upload link and email the passphrase via an out-of-band method. For convenience, I've CC'd Jordan (who will own the artifact creation) and Laura (who will coordinate redaction policy).

Action plan I propose:
1) Jordan will assemble the SCIM delta extract and service-account CSV.
2) Laura will draft the RBAC mappings and least-privilege note.
3) I will produce the SAML assertion sample and a short README describing redaction rules.

Can you confirm the upload method and whether encrypted tarball is acceptable?

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medicore.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Security Team <security@medicore.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2028 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + RBAC mapping for SIG follow-up

Hi Rishi,

Encrypted tarball is fine — we will accept the passphrase over Signal or a short phone call. For the SCIM delta, auditors asked that group membership deltas include the group display name, group id, and change type (add/update/delete). For service-account last_used, please include timezone-aware ISO timestamps.

Redaction rules: replace any user email with <redacted_email> unless it's in the owner column; owner emails may be left intact. Replace internal UUIDs with a stable mapping token (e.g., svc-0001) and include the mapping file.

I attached a partial service-account list we pulled; it should make matching easier. We'd like the initial artifacts by 2028-04-04 to allow an internal review before final delivery on 2028-04-05.

Thanks — Alice

Attachment: service_account_list.csv (partial)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medicore.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Mar 2028 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM delta + RBAC mapping for SIG follow-up

Thanks Alice — confirmed. Summary and next steps: 

- Deliverable 1 (by 2028-04-04): SCIM delta CSV (90 days) with fields: user_id_token, display_name, email_or_redacted, group_id, group_display_name, change_type, timestamp. We will include mapping file svc-mapping.csv for any replaced UUIDs.
- Deliverable 2 (by 2028-04-04): service_account_list.csv (complete), with last_used as ISO timestamps in UTC.
- Deliverable 3 (by 2028-04-05): RBAC role definitions and role_binding snapshot (role name -> allowed actions; role_binding rows will use token ids for subjects).
- Deliverable 4 (by 2028-04-05): SAML assertion sample (PII redacted) + 2-page least-privilege controls note.

We will upload a password-protected tar.gz to your secure portal: https://redwood.secureupload.example.com/ticket/MC-4582/upload (passphrase sent separately). Attachments in the upload: redwood_scim_sample.tar.gz (contains scim_delta.csv, svc-mapping.csv, saml_assertion_sample.xml, rbac_roles.csv, least_privilege.pdf).

Jordan, please own the SCIM delta and svc-mapping. Laura, please own RBAC write-up and ensure the role definitions include the permission set. I will review and push the tarball to the portal by EOD 2028-04-04.

Quoted for context:
> On Wed, 29 Mar 2028 at 08:17 AM Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@medicore.com> wrote:
> > For the SCIM delta, auditors asked that group membership deltas include the group display name, group id, and change type (add/update/delete).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we know timelines are tight.

Best,
Rishi

Attachment: redwood_scim_sample.tar.gz (contains artifacts described above)
